import pytest


def parity(x: int) -> bool:
    """True when the byte (an int from 0 to 255) has an odd number of set bits."""
    if not 0 <= x <= 255:
        raise ValueError(f"Value out of byte range [0, 255]: {x}")
    return x.bit_count() % 2 == 1


def test_parity() -> None:
    assert parity(0) is False
    assert parity(1) is True
    assert parity(2) is True
    assert parity(3) is False
    assert parity(7) is True
    assert parity(127) is True
    assert parity(255) is False
    assert parity(0b10101010) is False
    assert parity(0b10101011) is True


def test_parity_invalid_range() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parity(-1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parity(256)
